card.name: Linking words before anticholinergic drug examples
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas such as "including", "such as", "of" and "e.g.," right after "anticholinergic" or "antimuscarinic" agents, where example drugs are about to be listed.

modes.label: Including / such as
modes.description: A word that introduces a list of example drugs after anticholinergic or antimuscarinic agents.
modes.example: with the use of anticholinergic drugs such<< as>> Qbrexza.

modes.label: Comma or e.g. in a list
modes.description: A comma or "e.g.," inside a parenthetical list of anticholinergic drugs.
modes.example: comitant treatment with clozapine and other drugs with anticholinergic activity (e.g., benztropine, cyclobenzaprine<<,>> diphenhydramine) can

modes.label: Of after effects
modes.description: The word "of" after "anticholinergic effects", leading to the drug class affected.
modes.example: Drug Interactions MAO inhibitors prolong and intensify the anticholinergic effects<< of>> antihistamines.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward naming drug classes that block receptors, such as blockers, blockade and sympathetic terms.
card.plain: It fires on the small words that come just before a list of anticholinergic drug examples.
